propositions: A plan edited mid-review runs all remaining LLM passes and fails only at sign time when generation.sign_manifest detects own_material mismatch, wasting all post-edit computation and invalidating Pass-1 checkpoints keyed by material fingerprint
The cancel predicate must scope to own material only (not relation snapshot or related_material) to avoid reintroducing bug d70a false cancellations on unrelated ticket writes
Cancel signal must be out-of-band (not a step failure) because gate_dispatch.produce_plan_review_verdict attempts coach/verify recovery on step failures, flowing to signing and sidecar emission

The probe must perform no store-wide reduction, sync-lock acquisition, or tracker HEAD fetch—only a lightweight single-ticket attest.current_material_fingerprint under local_read_context to detect own-material changes at the two between-pass seams (verify_inputs and coach_inputs)
On cancel, return an INDETERMINATE verdict with plan-review-cancelled-stale finding, never reaching sign or sidecar code, with exit code 2 mapping to signal rerun
A mid-run write to an unrelated ticket or related_material drift alone must not cancel the review, preserving checkpoint reusability and deferring that conflict to sign-time refusal
